decision.text:
W3 integration decision following C story1220959504188117 and W2 structural-editor warning1220959471605219: please proceed in your owned source lane with the narrow native contract assessment/implementation required for both ordinary imported Bookmark creation and real Native structural editing. These remain product acceptance gaps; the current W3 shared-App source freeze is explicitly intermediate.
Bookmark: preserve generic creation compatibility; an optional expected-definition fence must bind the selected layout11 Type, attached property owner, sourceURL definition/UTF8 value and required editor/editor_blocks dataset at the actual native signed-writer boundary. Determine and document the original transaction/locking scope before claiming atomicity. If existing root-create and bootstrap remain separate effects, preserve any known object ID/ACK and reconcile read-only; no replacement POST after an ambiguous refusal. Bodyless layout11 must be proven with its real empty snapshot, no synthetic paragraph. W2 owns the public precreate read/UI seam and should keep this path unavailable until your concrete contract is published.
Native editor: actual Return must split blocks, and merge/Undo must preserve their identities and signed revision semantics. Separate CAS PATCH+POST is not an atomic split, and sticky tombstones cannot be treated as reversible identity restoration. Please return an explicit existing-writer transaction/Undo contract and focused original native evidence for split/merge/Undo or the exact remaining code gap. Do not broaden or replay the frozen C313/C3/1607 acceptance under the same identity; use a distinct follow-on source milestone and coordinate runtime after the current owner queue. Root remains sole final merge/build owner.
